bull.probability_evidence: Bull case: 90.6% TTM ROIC, 57.8% gross margin and a net-cash balance sheet trading 32-40% below peers (CROX/ONON/NKE/VFC) on P/E, EV/EBITDA and P/FCF, with FY2026 ROIC/ROCE/gross margin still near record levels -- i.e. the fundamentals have not yet shown the slowdown the price implies (research/DECK/2026-10-07-evaluation.md Bull case; factsheet-2026-10-07.md Quality and Valuation tables).

target_price_12m.cite: evaluation.md Decision block scenarios.bull.target_price_12m: P/E re-rates to its 5y minimum 13.9x from 11.3x on TTM EPS lifted by the 5.72% YoY share-count reduction

target_band.cite: Half the spread of the bull target priced on P/E (13.9x -> 106.20, factsheet-2026-10-07.md Valuation table), EV/EBITDA (9.3x -> ~107.05) and P/FCF (12.9x -> ~112.49), each 5y-minimum multiple applied to the same 5.72% buyback-driven per-share growth (factsheet Valuation and Other tables); spread $6.32 / 2 / $106.20 target = 2.96%

base.probability_evidence: Base case is the modal outcome: valuation already sits below every 5y minimum and peer multiple (factsheet-2026-10-07.md Valuation table) while TTM operating margin has slipped from 23.7% to 22.7% and the stock sits near 6-month/52-week lows with weak relative strength into the Oct 22 print (factsheet Price table; evaluation.md Bear case) -- consistent with a 'cheap but no further re-rating yet' status quo rather than a re-rate or a collapse.

target_price_12m.cite: evaluation.md Decision block scenarios.base.target_price_12m: P/FCF stays at 9.9x with flat FCF, FCF per share grows only by the 5.72% buyback-driven share-count reduction

target_band.cite: Base case holds the CURRENT multiple flat (P/E 11.3x, EV/EBITDA 7.5x and P/FCF 9.9x, factsheet-2026-10-07.md Valuation table) and grows only by the 5.72% buyback factor (Other table) -- because current price already equals each metric's current multiple, pricing the same growth off P/E, EV/EBITDA or P/FCF all converge on $86.33, so there is no cross-anchor disagreement in this scenario

bear.probability_evidence: Lowest-probability scenario: despite the 10-K's flagged 'pricing and promotional pressure', 18.5% customer concentration in receivables, a retailer naming HOKA among brands in a 'reset' and short interest up 20.4% to 7.02% of float (research/DECK/2026-10-07.md section 2 and 6; evaluation.md Bear case), FY2026 fundamentals (ROIC 104.4%, gross margin 57.7%, factsheet-2026-10-07.md Quality table) have not yet deteriorated to support a full margin reversion to FY2022 levels.

target_price_12m.cite: evaluation.md Decision block scenarios.bear.target_price_12m: operating margin reverts from 22.7% TTM to the FY2022 level of 18.0%, cutting earnings at an unchanged 11.3x P/E

target_band.cite: Bear case holds the CURRENT multiple flat (P/E 11.3x, EV/EBITDA 7.5x, P/FCF 9.9x, factsheet-2026-10-07.md Valuation table) and applies the same margin-cut factor (18.0%/22.7%, Quality table) to each -- all three anchors converge on $64.75, so there is no cross-anchor disagreement in this scenario
